sections.heading: Software alongside specialist services
sections.body:
Linkfields combines specialist services with our own software and reusable delivery IP. Our products span enterprise applications, continuous testing, document intelligence, banking analytics, education AI and cyber security.

Linkworks, testoriumz, VajraX and our AI SaaS solutions are available by licence, subscription or SaaS, with or without a Linkfields services engagement.
